analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains neutral, failing to break out of the 30-45 range. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. Volume is subdued at 0.70 of the 5-day average, indicating a search for direction within a consolidation phase. A potential Higher Low is forming as the 5-day low is above the 20-day low, but a clear trend reversal signal is absent. The price is consolidating between the 76,010 support and 89,550 resistance levels. Wait and see.

· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW): potential trend reversal upon breakout.

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.70x): reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 with accompanying volume.
